name: BROWSER_APPLICATION_TYPE
description: This entity represents the web browser application being used.  Examples: - Internet Explorer - Firefox - Safari - AOL - Playstation - iPhone - Xbox

name: BROWSER_GEOGRAPHIC_ADDRESS_INFORMATION
description: This entity captures information regarding geographic address information associated with the visitor's browser.

name: BROWSER_PLUG-IN
description: This is a lookup table for browser plug-ins.  Examples: - Adobe Acrobat - Windows Media Player Plug-in - ZingWeb Plug-in for Netscape - Cosmo Player 2.1 - RealPlayer G2 LiveConnect 32-bit - Shockwave Flash

name: BROWSER_PLUG-IN_XREF
description: This entity provides a cross-reference of a visitors browser to its plug-ins.

name: BROWSER_VERSION
description: This is the version of web browser application a being used.  Examples: - Internet Explorer 7.0 - Safari 3.1 - Firefox 2.0

name: CLICK_ACTION_TYPE
description: This is a code for the page action such as paging click, scrolling click, submit click, cancel click. The enterprise will have defined codes for the various actions a user might take with a click on their web site.

name: CLICK_ACTIVITY
description: This entity captures clickmap information; it is the information contained in the address of the link the user clicked on (URL/JS function).

name: CLICK_CONTEXT_TYPE
description: This entity indicates whether the page name or URL was used for the click activity (such as submitting information, requesting information, or moving around the page).

name: COOKIE
description: This entity captures user cookie information. It contains the content of cookies for all cookie types.

name: CRAWLER
description: This entity contains a list of crawler sites that have visited the web site of the business entity. A crawler is a program search engine that takes information from a web site.

name: CRAWLER_PERMISSION_TYPE
description: This is a code used to specify the type of permission that a crawler is allowed when accessing a web site or web page.

name: CRAWLER_WEB_PAGE_PERMISSION
description: This entity contains the access rights granted to a crawler for a specified web page.

name: CRAWLER_WEB_SITE_PERMISSION
description: This entity contains the access rights granted to a crawler for a specified web site.

name: CUSTOM_SEARCH_CLICK-THROUGH
description: This entity captures information regarding custom search click-through events. Search click-through events capture information regarding click-throughs that are a result of a visitor search action.

name: EXTENDED_SESSION_INFORMATION
description: This entity captures session-based information relating to the visitor's activities or site usage during their session.

name: PROGRAM_PAGE_VIEW_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding online application programs displayed on a given web page.

name: REFERRAL_WEB_AD
description: This entity is used to capture information about web ads that were used by customers to access the web site. The entity also has a relationship to information relevant to web ads such as start and end dates and cost information.  Example: - An ad for a virus scanning application the enterprise offer

name: SESSION_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding types of session attributes.  Examples: - Session basket activity - Maximum session metrics

name: VISITOR
description: This entity contains information about anonymous/unidentified contacts that are not known to the enterprise such as web site visitors. The visitor identification is linked to the contact point's persistent cookie via this entity. This allows the tracking of repeat visits to the enterprise's web site

name: VISITOR_BEHAVIOR_ANALYSIS
description: This entity captures information regarding various types of analysis that can be performed on visitors with regard to their browsing behavior.  Note: The assumption here is the web data used for this analysis may or may not reside inside the warehouse. An external analysis engine provides these resu

name: VISITOR_INPUT
description: This entity captures user-provided information similar to information provided in forms.  Examples: - Postal code - Email - Telephone number

name: VISITOR_LOGON
description: This entity captures the login information of a visitor.

name: VISITOR_LOGON_SYSTEM
description: This entity captures information regarding visitor logons to their system accounts.

name: VISITOR_LOGON_SYSTEM_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding the visitor identifier associated with the system logon name.

name: VISITOR_LOGON_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding visitor logon subtypes. Visitor logons can be to system account, social network or email accounts.

name: VISITOR_PATH_ANALYSIS
description: This entity captures information regarding the path traversed by a visitor. The pages viewed during a visitors site traversal will be captured in this entity.  Note: The assumption here is the web data used for this analysis may or may not reside inside the warehouse. An external analysis engine pro

name: VISITOR_PATH_ANALYSIS_ITEM_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding the relationship of products to the pages in the visitor's path analysis.  Examples: - Product added to shopping cart - Product purchased - Product removed from shopping cart - Product added to wish list - Product removed from wish list

name: WEB_AD
description: A marketing message that appears on a web site.

name: WEB_BANNER_AD
description: This entity contains marketing messages for a mix of images and text that is usually hosted by a third-party organization on a web page.  Example: - A blue sweater ad with an image of blue sweater that links to a retailer's web site

name: WEB_FORM
description: This entity captures information relating to forms utilized on the web site.  This is not the HTML name of the form, but an arbitrary name under which this form is configured (e.g., 'Checkout Form' and 'Login Form').

name: WEB_GROUP_PUBLISHER
description: A cross-reference of the actual publishers contained in a specific WEB SITE GROUP.

name: WEB_INTERACTION_SITE_TYPE
description: This is a code for the types of sites that the system can provide information on such as social network, blogs, and news feeds.

name: WEB_PAGE
description: This entity represents a collection of multimedia objects displayed to visitors via use of a web browsing application during visits to a web site. A web page can contain product information, marketing information, customer service information. It can also allow for interaction, in the form of the cr

name: WEB_PAGE_CONTEXT
description: This entity links the context with the web page being rendered.

name: WEB_PAGE_CREATIVE
description: This entity captures information regarding an associative entity that tracks various objects appearing on a web page.  Examples: - Header - Logo in upper left-hand corner - Picture centered - Product link - Standard footer bar with links

name: WEB_PAGE_ERROR
description: Captures information regarding errors received by visitors while viewing a web page.

name: WEB_PAGE_ERROR_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the various types of page view errors.  Example: - In page activity (credit cards not being accepted and a booking failing) as well as the standard sorts of JavaScript errors

name: WEB_PAGE_GENERATION_TYPE
description: This entity is used to classify the method involved in generating a web page.  Example: - Static versus dynamic page

name: WEB_PAGE_MM_OBJECT
description: This is an associative entity that tracks various objects appearing on a web page.  Example: - On web page #889243 is found the following objects: header, logo in upper left-hand corner, picture centered, product link, and standard footer bar with links.

name: WEB_PAGE_OBJECT_VIEW
description: This entity captures information regarding objects (images) displayed on a given web page.

name: WEB_PAGE_STATUS_CATEGORY
description: This entity captures information regarding the grouping domain for web page view error statuses.  Examples: - Credit card failure - JavaScript error - Specific page view error

name: WEB_PAGE_TEXT
description: This entity contains the text associated with this web page other than multimedia objects such as: - URL – the uniform resource locator associated with a WEB PAGE - Communication protocol – specifies a communication protocol such as http:// and ftp://

name: WEB_PAGE_TEXT_SECTION
description: This entity is the link to web page text unstructured data.

name: WEB_PAGE_VIEW
description: This entity stores the information about the actual WEB PAGEs displayed to an individual during a given WEB VISIT.  Example: - Home page - > product page - > casual wear - > sweaters -> blue sweater. Along with this chain of pages visited, information about bytes transferred, the time stamp when the

name: WEB_PAGE_VIEW_SUMMARY
description: This entity captures summary information regarding visitor session activities.

name: WEB_PLATFORM
description: This captures information regarding web output platform (channel instance) for ad orders.

name: WEB_SCENARIO_STEP
description: This entity captures information regarding the steps of a custom scenario event. This entity captures the steps processed within a visitor scenario.

name: WEB_SECTION_SUBTYPE
description: This entity represents a classification of the content for a web section subtype similar to sections of a newspaper. A web section subtype may be divided into several sections based on the content of the pages.  Examples: - Sports - Finance - Current news

name: WEB_SELF-HELP
description: A type of event where the customer/counterparty uses web self-help.

name: WEB_SERVER
description: This entity provides summary information about the physical server devices servicing a WEB VISIT.  Example: - Web server #3 PRIMERETAIL using port number 80 with secure connection, and running Apache software located in time zone 5 (EST)

name: WEB_SERVER_ACTIVITY
description: This entity provides operational metrics for a web server.  Examples: - Hits per minute - Delay time - Number of aborted requests

name: WEB_SERVER_INTERNET_PROTOCOL_ADDRESS
description: This entity captures the IP address(es) of a specific web server.

name: WEB_SERVER_SOFTWARE
description: This entity captures information about the software being utilized by the web server.  Examples: - Apache - IIS

name: WEB_SERVER_STATUS
description: This entity contains information regarding the status of the web server utilized by the enterprise.

name: WEB_SERVER_STATUS_CATEGORY
description: This is a grouping domain for web server status.  Examples: - Unknown - Informational - Successful - Redirection - Client error

name: WEB_SERVER_STATUS_TYPE
description: This is an entity used to provide information about web server status. This entity contains server codes pertaining to errors and other conditions of the server.  Example: - "401 - Page not Available"

name: WEB_SESSION_COOKIE
description: This entity captures information regarding cookies that are associated with visitor web visits.

name: WEB_SHOPPING_EXPERIENCE_FUNCTION_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding functions performed during shopping experience events.  Possible functions performed for shopping experience events are: - Added - Removed - View - Increased quantity - Decreased quantity - Purchase

name: WEB_SITE
description: This entity represents a collection of enterprise-owned web pages under a single domain name.  Example: - Teradata.com

name: WEB_SITE_BREADCRUMB
description: This entity stores information regarding web site breadcrumbs, which are the digital signals used to link pages viewed by visitors.

name: WEB_SITE_CONTENT_TYPE
description: This entity represents a classification of the content of a web site.  Examples: - Sports - News - Portal

name: WEB_SITE_CRAWLER
description: This entity contains a history of the web sites that have been accessed by specified crawlers.

name: WEB_SITE_ENTRY_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the description of the area of the site that was first visited (initial visit location in short), for example, 'DVD section' or 'mortgage application.'

name: WEB_SITE_GROUP
description: This entity groups web sites into classifications such as a computer and technology web site, cooking web site, and astronomy web site. A web site can be in many groups and a group contains many web sites. Also known as network.  One example of a group is a group of publisher sites that an ad or cam

name: WEB_SITE_GROUP_XREF
description: This entity groups web sites into classifications such as a computer and technology web site, cooking web site, and astronomy web site. A web site can be in many groups and a group contains many web sites.

name: WEB_SITE_NAVIGATION
description: This entity provides the site map independent of the fact that the pages that instantiate this structure may change over time.  For example, "Blue suede shoes" page could be part of the "Elvis collection" class hierarchy or the "Men's Shoes" class hierarchy. Over time, "Blue suede shoes" could also

name: WEB_SITE_SECTION
description: This entity represents divisions of a web site such as Yahoo Sports or Yahoo Finance in order to divide large web sites into smaller divisions of related web pages that contain similar content.  Additional examples of web site sections could be: - Online versions of print publications - Web site use

name: WEB_SITE_SERVER
description: This entity associates the web sites that are supported by a web server.  Example: - Web site #25 is supported by web server #18 with a backup web server #19 - Web site #1 is supported by a server group including web server #8-15

name: WEB_SITE_SUBSTITUTE_SECTION
description: This entity captures information regarding the subsections within a web site section.

name: WEB_SITE_SUBSTITUTE_SECTION_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the various types of web site substitute sections.

name: WEB_SITE_SUBTYPE
description: This entity is used to classify a web site as referring or microsite.

name: WEB_SITE_USER_SPACE
description: This entity supports the concept of a user space within a web site.  Typically, used for social networking sites (Myspace and Facebook), and other web publishers that allow users to set up their own user space.  This entity also groups all owned pages of the user space together.  Web visitors can be

name: WEB_TEXT_AD
description: This entity contains marketing messages using text descriptions intended for placement on a web page.  Example: - A text message saying 'Buy Blue Sweaters' that is linked to a retail web site's blue sweater page

name: WEB_VISIT
description: This entity represents a visit during which an internet web site is accessed by an individual using the world wide web.  Example: - An unknown visitor browsed our web site today from 12:32 through 13:47.

name: WEB_VISIT_INTERNET_PROTOCOL_XREF
description: This entity provides linkage of visitor sessions to their various IP addresses used to connect to the enterprise's web site during the session. Via usage of dynamic IP address assignments, a visitor may use multiple different IP addresses to connect to the enterprise's web site during the session. T

name: WEB_VISIT_SUBTYPE
description: This code is used as a subtype discriminator such as for extended session information.

name: WEB_VISIT_SUMMARY
description: This entity captures derived summary information regarding visitor session activities.
